title: Hardly Working: Start-up Guys
summary: A CollegeHumor sketch from the Hardly Working series in which a pair of startup founders pitch a website using incomprehensible buzzwords and branding nonsense. It parodies Silicon Valley startup culture.
why: HN commenters cite it as the go-to parody of startup pitch culture whenever buzzword-heavy startups come up.

quote.text: The did a great parody of many startup pitches that I've heard over the years.
